rows.25:7efc:
We all rushed out into the hallway and slammed the restroom door shut as hard as we could.
Having lost their target, the cockroaches rustled and scrabbled on the other side of the door.
"Let's hurry back to the club room!☆"
{f:We|We} ran off in a blind frenzy.
At that moment, {f:I|I} felt a sense of mission as a member of the newspaper club.
Telling myself that this was exactly how a scary story should be...
To an onlooker, {f:I|I} might seem like someone with unbelievable nerves.
After this, I can hardly go calling other people weird{f:, can I|, can I}?
"Of course, we're still going to keep the scary stories going.
So be ready for it!"
That's what {f:I|I} was telling everyone as I ran.{p}
rows.25:9298: But no matter how much we called and screamed, the seniors who were supposed to be in the hallway showed no sign of coming to help us.
rows.25:bd30:
"Oh, sorry, sorry.
It's nothing. Nothing at all."
Hosoda said, looking as if he had caught himself.
Then he turned his face away so he wouldn't have to look at me.
...Could Hosoda see someone standing behind me?
I turned around one more time.{p}
rows.25:c664:
Just then, an upside-down human silhouette appeared on the frosted glass.
"Eek!"
I leapt back without thinking.
Even through the frosted glass, I could make out the shadow's expressions.
It laughed, raged, grieved, cycling from one to the next, and then the shadow vanished.{p}
rows.25:ccdc:
"Bang☆"
Then the door slammed shut.
"Oh no, not again!"
I grabbed the knob to open the door, but it wouldn't open.
I was right back where I had been before.
"For now, I have to calm down..."{p}
rows.25:d0f0:
Then a gurgling sound came from the toilet.
"★"
Pathetically, my legs had given out under me.
"Hosoda!
This is bad!
...Hosoda★"
He had long since gotten back up.
Something about him was off.
"...I told you not to come out yet.
You're so impatient."
He started walking toward the toilet.
Then he stuck his face into the toilet and began mumbling something.
Whatever happens, I have to get out of here☆
My legs had given out, and I couldn't move the way I wanted.
Now Hosoda had plunged his hand into the toilet.
With a squelching, sucking sound, he seemed to pull out something black.{p}
rows.25:e7d0:
Wriggling its half-shattered, twisted jaw, it {f:seemed|seemed} to be desperately trying to tell me something.
"Help me... help me... it hurts, my head hurts..."
"{f:Waaaaaaaaah|Nooooooooo}☆"
The scream I had tried so hard to let out, and couldn't, now burst out of me before I even realized it.{p}
